_readme: Crosswalk from the platform's index codes to EIA open-data series (route petroleum/pri/spt, daily spot prices, $/gal). Free API key: https://www.eia.gov/opendata/register.php, then set EIA_API_KEY on the agent. The OPIS Dallas rack averages have no free equivalent, so Gulf Coast pipeline spot prices stand in for them, and New York Harbor spot stands in for the NYMEX front-month futures. The name and source here replace the index labels once the feed is live, so the Market page says what it shows. Dry run: npx tsx scripts/check-eia.ts

OPIS-DAL-ULSD.name: Gulf Coast ULSD spot (EIA; stands in for the Dallas rack average)

OPIS-DAL-UNL87.name: Gulf Coast conventional gasoline spot (EIA; stands in for the Dallas rack average)

NYMEX-RBOB.name: New York Harbor conventional gasoline spot (EIA)
